subject: SF customer roundtable: PO request, spend cap, and reimbursement flow
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Singh <priya@oasisvenues.com>; Oasis Venues Accounting <acct@oasisvenues.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SF customer roundtable: PO request, spend cap, and reimbursement flow

Hi Priya / Oasis team —

Thanks for the updated quote (great run of show). We want to lock the 22-Jun date for our SF customer roundtable. Finance has asked for a PO for the non-refundable venue deposit and a clear spend cap for the event. Summary below: 

- Total estimated event budget: $18,500 (venue + AV + F&B for ~60 pax + badges/printing + contingency)
- Non-refundable venue deposit required: $5,000 (due within 10 days)
- Remaining invoice schedule: final invoice 30 days after event

Can you confirm the attached PDF quote filename (Oasis-quote-SF-roundtable-041426.pdf) is final and provide your W9 so procurement can process the PO? We prefer DocuSign for the PO if that works.

Internal asks: 
- Marissa: can you issue a PO for $18,500 with a $5,000 deposit line and code it to cost center 4302 · Field Programs? If procurement needs a different cost center code, let me know.
- Ben: please confirm any vendor pcard limitations and whether Oasis accepts a card for the deposit (we may request a card hold + invoice).

Priya — once we have the PO + W9 we’ll route payment. Also call out any line items you need us to advance (AV tech lead fee, final clean-up charge).

Thanks,
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Field Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182

Attachment: Oasis-quote-SF-roundtable-041426.pdf

From: Priya Singh <priya@oasisvenues.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: Oasis Venues Accounting <acct@oasisvenues.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 16 Apr 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SF customer roundtable: PO request, spend cap, and reimbursement flow

Hi Sofia —

Thanks — quote is final. W9 attached (Oasis-W9-2026.pdf). We can accept either a card for the $5,000 deposit or a vendor invoice tied to a PO; DocuSign for the PO is fine. A couple quick notes on line items: 

- AV tech lead (onsite) requires a $1,250 advance to hold the engineer for the day.
- Catering final headcount cutoff is 7 days before event; final invoice adjusts to actuals.
- We do charge a small overtime fee if event runs past contracted end time (we’ll flag if that looks likely).

I’ll loop accounting on our end — they can accept ACH or card. If Redwood wants to use pcard for deposit please advise billing contact and limit.

Best,
Priya Singh
Senior Account Manager, Oasis Venues
priya@oasisvenues.com | 415-867-3000

Attachment: Oasis-W9-2026.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 17 Apr 2026 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: SF customer roundtable: PO request, spend cap, and reimbursement flow

Sofia —

Thanks for the details and the attachments. Finance is good to issue a PO; please confirm we should code to cost center 4302 (Field Programs) and project tag "SF-RT-0622". Once you confirm I'll generate PO RED-PO-2026-0347 for $18,500 with a $5,000 deposit line and send to Oasis via DocuSign. 

A few internal notes for the event: 
- For vendor deposit on pcard: we can put $5,000 on the event pcard if Ben confirms the available limit. If not, finance will issue ACH upon receipt of signed PO and W9.
- Reimbursements: staff OOP expenses (Uber, small supplies) — require uploaded receipts and code to project tag above; standard per diem not applicable. Receipts under $75 can be submitted in a grouped expense report, anything above needs line-item detail.
- Please ensure any speaker honoraria have contract routing separate from vendor PO (we'll need SOWs for external contractors).

Confirm cost center & project tag and I'll push the PO.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Finance Business Partner | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya@oasisvenues.com>, Oasis Venues Accounting <acct@oasisvenues.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2026 16:30:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: SF customer roundtable: PO request, spend cap, and reimbursement flow

All — confirming cost center 4302 and project tag "SF-RT-0622". Proceed with PO RED-PO-2026-0347 for $18,500 ($5,000 deposit line).

Ben — please confirm pcard availability for $5,000 deposit or advise if we need ACH. If pcard is used, please make a quick note of the merchant name as "Oasis Venues" and route the merchant receipt to accounting.

Priya — once you receive the DocuSign PO please return the signed copy and invoice for the deposit. For reimbursements after the event: we will submit expense reports (receipts attached) and route to project tag; Marissa, please confirm expected processing SLA for event reimbursements (typical is 7-10 business days after submission).

Thanks everyone — aiming to have PO out to Oasis by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Field Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai

Quote attached: Oasis-quote-SF-roundtable-041426.pdf
PO template attached: Redwood-PO-template-v2.xlsx
